solutions.name: Wood-Panel Lamination
solutions.seoTitle: Wood-Panel Lamination Materials & Press Tooling | Moldart
solutions.metaDesc: Wood-panel press tooling, papers, films and laminate inputs organised around the actual stack, process and approval route.
solutions.overview: Use this route when the surface result depends on the complete wood-panel press stack rather than one item in isolation.
considerations: Define the pressed product, target surface and actual press stack.
Keep wood-panel tooling separate from electronics lamination materials.
Confirm each paper, film, plate and pad against its own evidence and trial basis.
Lock the approved sample and receiving checks before repeat supply.

flow.title: Define the target surface
flow.detail: State the pressed product, finish reference and acceptance route.

flow.title: Align the press stack
flow.detail: Confirm the tooling, paper or film role and the actual process window.

flow.title: Approve and retain
flow.detail: Record the accepted sample, evidence, trial result and reorder reference.

productRoles.press-plates: Transfers the approved surface condition in the wood-panel press stack.
productRoles.press-pads: Supports heat transfer and pressure equalisation for the specified press duty.
productRoles.decor-paper: Carries the approved printed design into impregnation and pressing.
productRoles.melamine-impregnated-paper: Provides the specified décor, overlay, underlay or balancing-paper role.
productRoles.decorative-films-foils: Provides a polymer-specific surface route where paper is not the selected construction.
productRoles.genuine-vegetable-parchment: Supports the specified lamination, edge or postforming process route.
productRoles.hpl-compact-laminated-boards: Represents the HPL, compact or HPL-faced output after construction is fixed.

visual.homeSummary: Press tooling, papers and films aligned to the real stack and approved surface.
visual.storyNote: Read the tooling, paper or film and process window together.

solutions.name: Furniture & Cabinetry
solutions.metaDesc: Boards, laminates, surface materials and component approval inputs for furniture and cabinetry programmes.
solutions.overview: Use this route for engineered boards, surfaces and drawing-led components—not an unsupported finished-furniture promise.
considerations: Start with the component map, dimensions and use environment.
Match the board and surface route to machining, edge and hardware needs.
Use drawings, BOMs and finish samples for component approval.
Confirm packing, labels and reorder references before dispatch.

flow.title: Map the component
flow.detail: Record the drawing, dimensions, use and quantity.

flow.title: Choose board and surface
flow.detail: Align the core, face, edge, machining and hardware route.

flow.title: Approve for dispatch
flow.detail: Lock the sample, packing, labels and reorder reference.

productRoles.fiberboard: Provides a smooth core route for paint, lamination and precision conversion.
productRoles.particleboard: Supports repeat commercial furniture components where construction and machining are controlled.
productRoles.plywood: Supports components where core build and structural behaviour matter.
productRoles.osb: Supports selected structural or visible strand-surface component routes.
productRoles.hpl-compact-laminated-boards: Provides HPL, compact or HPL-faced constructions after substrate and use are fixed.
productRoles.decor-paper: Provides the approved printed design route.
productRoles.melamine-impregnated-paper: Provides décor or balancing-paper roles for faced boards.
productRoles.decorative-films-foils: Provides polymer-specific wrapping, forming or lamination routes.

visual.homeSummary: Boards, surfaces and component evidence aligned before commercial comparison.
visual.storyNote: Keep finished-furniture claims out unless a specific approved programme supports them.

solutions.name: Laminate Flooring
solutions.metaDesc: Laminate flooring construction, use class, core, joint, site and accessory inputs reviewed as one system.
solutions.overview: Use this route for laminate flooring systems; it is not an engineered-wood flooring claim.
considerations: Confirm construction and supported use class.
Review core, joint and surface as one system.
Record subfloor, moisture, acclimatisation and expansion conditions.
Coordinate underlay, skirting, transitions and stair details with the approved floor.

flow.title: Define construction and use
flow.detail: Confirm the floor build and applicable test evidence.

flow.title: Check core, joint and site
flow.detail: Review the locking route and actual installation conditions.

flow.title: Coordinate accessories
flow.detail: Map underlay, skirting, transitions and receiving checks.

productRoles.wood-flooring: Provides the approved laminate-flooring construction and joint route.
productRoles.fiberboard: Supports the specified HDF or other core route where evidence applies.
productRoles.decor-paper: Provides the printed surface design used in the approved construction.
productRoles.melamine-impregnated-paper: Provides applicable décor, overlay or balancing-paper roles.

visual.homeSummary: Construction, joint, site and accessories reviewed as one floor system.
visual.storyNote: Treat the floor, site and accessories as one approval route.

solutions.name: HPL, CPL, LPL & Decorative Surfaces
solutions.seoTitle: HPL, CPL, LPL & Decorative Surface Routes | Moldart
solutions.metaDesc: Compare HPL, compact, LPL, papers and polymer films by construction, substrate, process and approval route.
solutions.overview: Use this route when the buyer must choose a surface construction before selecting the paper, film, board and press inputs.
considerations: Separate HPL, compact, LPL and polymer-film constructions.
Identify the substrate and process before comparing appearance.
Approve colour, texture, gloss and edge behaviour with a physical sample.
Keep printing-cylinder discussion inside décor-paper process guidance only.

flow.title: Choose the surface route
flow.detail: Fix HPL, compact, LPL, paper or polymer-film construction.

flow.title: Match substrate and process
flow.detail: Confirm the board, adhesive or resin and press or forming route.

flow.title: Approve visible output
flow.detail: Retain the colour, texture, gloss and edge reference.

productRoles.hpl-compact-laminated-boards: Provides HPL, compact and faced-board constructions.
productRoles.melamine-impregnated-paper: Provides LPL and related impregnated-paper roles.
productRoles.decorative-films-foils: Provides PP, PVC, PET or PETG surface routes.
productRoles.genuine-vegetable-parchment: Supports specified process and postforming routes.
productRoles.press-plates: Controls texture transfer where press tooling applies.
productRoles.press-pads: Supports the specified wood-panel press stack.

visual.homeSummary: Surface construction, substrate and process selected before appearance is approved.
visual.storyNote: Do not treat paper, laminate and polymer film as interchangeable finishes.

solutions.name: Formwork & Shuttering
solutions.metaDesc: Formwork plywood face, core, edge, release, trial-casting and accepted-use controls prepared before procurement.
solutions.overview: Use this route when accepted concrete output and cost per accepted use matter more than the first sheet price.
considerations: Define the formwork system, concrete finish and reuse expectation.
Confirm face, core, bond and edge-seal evidence.
Use trial casting and an accepted-use log rather than a universal cycle claim.
Record cleaning, release-agent, repair and rejection criteria.

flow.title: Define the formwork duty
flow.detail: State system, concrete finish and handling conditions.

flow.title: Approve the panel and trial
flow.detail: Review face, core, edge and a controlled trial casting.

flow.title: Track accepted use
flow.detail: Log cleaning, repair, rejection and cost per accepted use.

productRoles.plywood: Provides the specified formwork panel construction.
productRoles.osb: Supports only the formwork or structural route where grade evidence applies.
productRoles.press-plates: Supports texture or face-production inputs where the panel programme requires them.

visual.homeSummary: Panel construction and site controls tied to accepted concrete output.
visual.storyNote: Do not replace a trial and log with a universal reuse promise.

solutions.name: Architecture & Elevators
solutions.seoTitle: Decorative Stainless Steel for Architecture & Elevators | Moldart
solutions.metaDesc: Decorative stainless sheets, trims and drawing-led applications controlled through grade, finish, sample, fabrication and packing.
solutions.overview: Use this route when visible finish, joint detail, support build-up, fabrication and site receiving must be approved together.
considerations: Match grade to the actual environment.
Approve finish, colour and direction on a physical sample.
Coordinate profiles, joints, fabrication and support boards from drawings.
Protect the approved surface through film, packing, handling and receiving.

flow.title: Define environment and finish
flow.detail: State grade basis, exposure and finish master.

flow.title: Coordinate drawings and joints
flow.detail: Review profiles, fabrication, support and installation details.

flow.title: Protect through receiving
flow.detail: Lock film, packing, handling and site acceptance.

productRoles.decorative-panels: Provides the approved visible sheet and finish route.
productRoles.ss-profiles: Controls trims, transitions, joints and inlay details.
productRoles.plywood: Supports applicable backing or interior component routes.
productRoles.fiberboard: Supports applicable smooth backing or laminated interior routes.
productRoles.hpl-compact-laminated-boards: Supports compact or faced-board applications where specified.

visual.homeSummary: Visible stainless surfaces, profiles and support materials aligned to drawings and receiving.
visual.storyNote: The physical sample and drawing control the visible result.

solutions.name: Decorative Metal Finishing
solutions.seoTitle: Decorative Metal Finishing & Stainless Surfaces | Moldart
solutions.metaDesc: Mirror, hairline, satin, No. 4, etched, embossed, PVD and AFP stainless routes reviewed through physical samples.
solutions.overview: Use this route when base material, finish family, colour continuity, fabrication and cleaning affect acceptance.
considerations: Fix the base grade and finish family before comparing quotations.
Approve colour, gloss, direction and surface on a physical master.
Check forming, welding, film and fabrication compatibility.
Define cleaning and receiving methods that will not damage the finish.

flow.title: Fix base and finish
flow.detail: Confirm grade, surface preparation and finish family.

flow.title: Approve colour and sample
flow.detail: Set the visual master and viewing basis.

flow.title: Control fabrication and cleaning
flow.detail: Protect the approved finish through conversion and use.

productRoles.decorative-panels: Provides the principal decorative sheet and finish route.
productRoles.ss-profiles: Keeps trims and dividers aligned with the approved finish.

visual.homeSummary: Base grade, finish master and fabrication controlled as one route.
visual.storyNote: Catalogue images do not replace the approved physical finish sample.

solutions.name: PCB, CCL, FPC, Smart-Card & IC-Substrate Lamination
solutions.seoTitle: PCB, CCL, FPC & IC-Substrate Press Systems | Moldart
solutions.metaDesc: Electronics press tooling, cushion materials and films separated by function, stack position, metrology, cleanliness and trial basis.
solutions.overview: Use this route for electronics lamination only; keep its tooling, pads, films, evidence and RFQ fields separate from wood-panel pressing.
considerations: Start with the electronics product stack and exact tooling or film role.
Confirm dimensions, process window, metrology and cleanliness methods.
Keep plate, pad, release, conformal, carrier and protection functions separate.
Run the applicable trial and incoming inspection before production release.

flow.title: Map the product stack
flow.detail: Identify product, stack position and exact material function.

flow.title: Lock process and measurement
flow.detail: Set the process window, drawing, cleanliness and metrology basis.

flow.title: Trial and receive
flow.detail: Approve the trial and record incoming inspection and storage controls.

productRoles.industrial-press-plates: Provides drawing- and metrology-controlled press plates and related tooling.
productRoles.electronics-press-pads: Provides application-qualified cushion materials for the specified electronics stack.
productRoles.electronics-lamination-films: Provides release, conformal, carrier or protection functions without conflating them.

visual.homeSummary: Tooling, cushion materials and films separated by function and process evidence.
visual.storyNote: Do not import wood-panel assumptions into electronics lamination.
